sentences.zh: 賜死者材器，並加振恤。

translations.literal: Coffins and materials were granted to the dead, with added relief.
translations.idiomatic: Coffins and materials were granted to the dead, with added relief.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，蠲遇水資財漂蕩者今年調稅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on yisi, this year's taxes and levies were remitted for those whose property was swept away by flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on yisi, that year's taxes and levies were remitted for those whose property was swept away by flood.

sentences.zh: 又詔為馬圈戰亡將士舉哀。

translations.literal: Also an edict ordered mourning for officers and soldiers killed at Horse Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered mourning for officers and soldiers killed at Horse Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，揚州刺史始安王遙光據東府反。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Governor of Yang Province Prince of Shi'an Yaoguang occupied Eastern Headquarters in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Governor of Yang Province Prince of Shi'an Yaoguang occupied Eastern Headquarters in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 詔曲赦都下，中外戒嚴，遣領軍將軍蕭坦之致討。

translations.literal: An edict partially amnestied the capital; inner and outer quarters were placed under strict guard; Commandant of the Guards Xiao Tanzhi was dispatched to suppress.
translations.idiomatic: An edict partially amnestied the capital; inner and outer quarters were placed under strict guard; Commandant of the Guards Xiao Tanzhi was dispatched to suppress.

sentences.zh: 戊午，斬遙光，傳首。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Yaoguang was beheaded; his head was sent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Yaoguang was beheaded; his head was sent.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以尚書令徐孝嗣為司空，以領軍蕭坦之為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On jisi, Director of the Masters of Writing Xu Xiaosi was made Minister of Works; Commandant of the Guards Xiao Tanzhi was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Director of the Masters of Writing Xu Xiaosi was made Minister of Works; Commandant of the Guards Xiao Tanzhi was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙子，以江陵公寶覽為始安王。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on bingzi, Duke of Jiangling BaoLan was installed as Prince of Shi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on bingzi, Duke of Jiangling BaoLan was installed as Prince of Shi'an.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，殺尚書左僕射蕭坦之，右衛將軍曹武。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on jiachen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xiao Tanzhi and General of the Right Guard Cao Wu were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiachen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xiao Tanzhi and General of the Right Guard Cao Wu were killed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，殺領軍將軍劉暄。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Commandant of the Guards Liu Xuan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Commandant of the Guards Liu Xuan was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以頻殺大臣，大赦。

translations.literal: On renxu, because ministers were frequently killed, general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, because ministers were frequently killed, general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，誅尚書令新除司空徐孝嗣、右僕射新除鎮軍將軍沈文季。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on yiwei, the newly appointed Minister of Works Xu Xiaosi and newly appointed General Who Garrisons the Army Shen Wenji were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on yiwei, the newly appointed Minister of Works Xu Xiaosi and newly appointed General Who Garrisons the Army Shen Wenji were executed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以吳興太守蕭惠休為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Governor of Wuxing Xiao Huiqiu was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Governor of Wuxing Xiao Huiqiu was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以侍中王亮為左僕射。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Attendant-in-Ordinary Wang Liang was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Attendant-in-Ordinary Wang Liang was made Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，太尉、江州刺史陳顯達舉兵反于尋陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on bingchen, Grand Commandant and Governor of Jiang Province Chen Xianda raised troops in rebellion at Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on bingchen, Grand Commandant and Governor of Jiang Province Chen Xianda raised troops in rebellion at Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，加護軍將軍崔慧景平南將軍，督眾軍南討。

translations.literal: On yichou, General Who Protects the Army Cui Huijing was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South and commanded the mass of armies south to suppress.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, General Who Protects the Army Cui Huijing was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South and commanded the mass of armies south to suppress.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，陳顯達至都，宮城嚴警。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on jiashen, Chen Xianda reached the capital; the palace city was strictly guarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jiashen, Chen Xianda reached the capital; the palace city was strictly guarded.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，斬顯達，傳其首。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Xianda was beheaded; his head was sent.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xianda was beheaded; his head was sent.

sentences.zh: 餘党盡平。

translations.literal: The remaining partisans were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining partisans were entirely pacified.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚午，詔討豫州刺史裴叔業。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month on gengwu, an edict ordered suppression of Governor of Yu Province Pei Shuye.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month on gengwu, an edict ordered suppression of Governor of Yu Province Pei Shuye.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，叔業病死，兄子植以壽春降魏。

translations.literal: In the second month on jichou, Shuye died of illness; nephew Zhi surrendered Shouyang to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jichou, Shuye died of illness; nephew Zhi surrendered Shouyang to Wei.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，命平西將軍崔慧景攻壽春。

translations.literal: In the third month on yimao, Pacifying-West General Cui Huijing was ordered to attack Shouyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on yimao, Pacifying-West General Cui Huijing was ordered to attack Shouyang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，尚書右僕射蕭惠休卒。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xiao Huiqiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xiao Huiqiu died.

sentences.zh: 丁未，崔慧景於廣陵反，舉兵內向。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Cui Huijing rebelled at Guangling and raised troops inward.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Cui Huijing rebelled at Guangling and raised troops inward.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命右衛將軍左興盛督都下水步眾軍禦之。

translations.literal: On renzi, General of the Right Guard Zuo Xingsheng was ordered to command capital water and land armies to resist.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, General of the Right Guard Zuo Xingsheng was ordered to command capital water and land armies to resist.

sentences.zh: 南徐州刺史江夏王寶玄以京城納慧景。

translations.literal: Governor of South Xu Province Prince of Jiangxia Baoquan admitted Huijing into the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of South Xu Province Prince of Jiangxia Baoquan admitted Huijing into the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣中領軍王瑩率眾軍屯北籬門。

translations.literal: On yimao, Central Commandant Wang Ying was ordered to lead the mass of armies and garrison North Hedge Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Central Commandant Wang Ying was ordered to lead the mass of armies and garrison North Hedge Gate.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，慧景至，瑩等敗績。

translations.literal: On renxu, Huijing arrived; Ying and others were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Huijing arrived; Ying and others were defeated.

sentences.zh: 甲子，慧景入建鄴，台城內閉門拒守。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Huijing entered Jianye; within the terrace city gates were closed in refusal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Huijing entered Jianye; within the terrace city gates were closed in refusal.

sentences.zh: 豫州刺史蕭懿興兵入援。

translations.literal: Governor of Yu Province Xiao Yi raised troops to enter in aid.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Yu Province Xiao Yi raised troops to enter in aid.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以懿為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On jisi, Yi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Yi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，慧景棄眾走，斬之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on guiyou, Huijing abandoned his troops and fled; he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on guiyou, Huijing abandoned his troops and fled; he was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 詔曲赦都下及南徐、南兗二州。

translations.literal: An edict partially amnestied the capital and South Xu and South Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: An edict partially amnestied the capital and South Xu and South Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以新除尚書右僕射蕭懿為尚書令。

translations.literal: On yihai, the newly appointed Right Vice Director Xiao Yi was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the newly appointed Right Vice Director Xiao Yi was made Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以中領軍王瑩為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Central Commandant Wang Ying was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Central Commandant Wang Ying was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉，江夏王寶玄伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jiyou, Prince of Jiangxia Baoquan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jiyou, Prince of Jiangxia Baoquan was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，赦。

translations.literal: On renzi, amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，曲赦都下及南徐、兗二州。

translations.literal: On yichou, partial amnesty in the capital and South Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, partial amnesty in the capital and South Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，車駕于樂游苑內會，如三元，都下放女人觀。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on gengyin, the imperial carriage held an assembly within Leyou Park like the three first-days; the capital released women to watch.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on gengyin, the imperial carriage held an assembly within Leyou Park like the three first-days; the capital released women to watch.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰夜，宮內火，唯東合內明帝舊殿數區及太極以南得存，餘皆蕩盡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on the night of jiachen, fire broke out within the palace; only several sections of Emperor Ming's old halls in the eastern wing and south of the Grand Ultimate survived — the rest were entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn on the night of jiachen, fire broke out within the palace; only several sections of Emperor Ming's old halls in the eastern wing and south of the Grand Ultimate survived — the rest were entirely destroyed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，殺尚書令蕭懿。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jimao, Director of the Masters of Writing Xiao Yi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on jimao, Director of the Masters of Writing Xiao Yi was killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，西中郎長史蕭穎胄起兵於荊州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on jiayin, Western Palace Chief Clerk Xiao Yingzhou raised troops in Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiayin, Western Palace Chief Clerk Xiao Yingzhou raised troops in Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月，雍州刺史蕭衍起兵於襄陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Governor of Yong Province Xiao Yan raised troops in Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Governor of Yong Province Xiao Yan raised troops in Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏宣武皇帝景明元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Jingming of Emperor Xuanwu of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of Jingming of Emperor Xuanwu of Wei.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙申朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month on the first day, bingchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, first month on the first day, bingchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 帝與宮人于閱武堂元會，皇后正位，閹人行儀，帝戎服臨視。

translations.literal: The emperor with palace women held the New Year assembly at Review Troops Hall; the empress took the formal seat; eunuchs performed ritual; the emperor in martial dress observed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor with palace women held the New Year assembly at Review Troops Hall; the empress took the formal seat; eunuchs performed ritual; the emperor in martial dress observed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以驃騎大將軍晉安王寶義為司徒，以新除撫軍將軍建安王寶寅為車騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Rapid Cavalry General Prince of Jin'an Baoqi was made Grand Tutor; newly appointed General Who Pacifies the Army Prince of Jian'an Baoyin was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with an office opening at ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Rapid Cavalry General Prince of Jin'an Baoqi was made Grand Tutor; newly appointed General Who Pacifies the Army Prince of Jian'an Baoyin was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with an office opening at ceremonial parity with the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，長星見，竟天。

translations.literal: On yisi, a long comet appeared spanning the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, a long comet appeared spanning the sky.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀南郊，大赦，詔百官陳讜言。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; general amnesty; an edict ordered officials to present remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; general amnesty; an edict ordered officials to present remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，幹和殿西廂火。

translations.literal: In the second month on bingyin, fire in the western wing of Ganhe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on bingyin, fire broke out in the western wing of Ganhe Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔遣羽林兵征雍州，中外纂嚴。

translations.literal: On renwu, an edict dispatched Feathered Forest soldiers to campaign against Yong Province; inner and outer quarters placed under strict guard.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, an edict dispatched Feathered Forest soldiers to campaign against Yong Province; inner and outer quarters placed under strict guard.

sentences.zh: 始內橫吹五部於殿內，晝夜奏之。

translations.literal: First the five sections of horizontal pipes were placed within the hall; day and night they played.
translations.idiomatic: First the five sections of horizontal pipes were placed within the hall; day and night they played.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，蚩尤旗見。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Chiyou banner appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Chiyou banner appeared.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，南康王寶融即皇帝位於江陵。

translations.literal: In the third month on yisi, Prince of Nankang Baorong ascended the throne at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on yisi, Prince of Nankang Baorong ascended the throne at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣平西將軍陳伯之西征。

translations.literal: On guichou, Pacifying-West General Chen Bozhi was dispatched on western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Pacifying-West General Chen Bozhi was dispatched on western campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月，蕭穎胄弟穎孚起兵廬陵。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, younger brother of Xiao Yingzhou Yingfu raised troops in Luling.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, younger brother of Xiao Yingzhou Yingfu raised troops in Luling.

sentences.zh: 戊子，赦江州安成、廬陵二郡。

translations.literal: On wuzi, amnesty in Ancheng and Luling commanderies of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, amnesty in Ancheng and Luling commanderies of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，曲赦荊、雍二州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on guisi, partial amnesty in Jing and Yong provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn on guisi, partial amnesty in Jing and Yong provinces.

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史張欣泰、前南譙太守王靈秀率石頭文武奉建安王寶寅向台，至杜姥宅，宮門閉，乃散走。

translations.literal: Governor of Yong Province Zhang Xintai and former Governor of South Qiao Wang Lingxiu led Shitou civil and military officials to support Prince of Jian'an Baoyin toward the terrace — reaching Old Woman Du's residence, the palace gate closed, then scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Yong Province Zhang Xintai and former Governor of South Qiao Wang Lingxiu led Shitou civil and military officials to support Prince of Jian'an Baoyin toward the terrace — reaching Old Woman Du's residence, the palace gate closed, then they scattered and fled.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，龍鬥于建康淮，激水五里。

translations.literal: On bingchen, dragons fought on the Jianye Huai River; water surged five li.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, dragons fought on the Jianye Huai River; water surged five li.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，以太子左率李居士總督西討諸軍事，屯新亭。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on xinmao, Left Leader of the Crown Prince Li Jushi was made overall commander of western suppression military affairs and garrisoned Xinting.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinmao, Left Leader of the Crown Prince Li Jushi was made overall commander of western suppression military affairs and garrisoned Xinting.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，蕭衍至南豫州，輔國將軍、監南豫州事申胄軍二萬人于姑孰奔歸。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on jiachen, Xiao Yan reached South Yu Province; General Who Supports the State and Supervisor of South Yu Province Shen Zhou's army of twenty thousand at Gushu fled back.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiachen, Xiao Yan reached South Yu Province; General Who Supports the State and Supervisor of South Yu Province Shen Zhou's army of twenty thousand at Gushu fled back.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，李居士與衍軍戰於新亭，見敗。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Li Jushi fought Yan's army at Xinting and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Li Jushi fought Yan's army at Xinting and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，王珍國又戰敗於朱雀航。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jiaxu, Wang Zhenguo was again defeated at Zhuque Floating Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on jiaxu, Wang Zhenguo was again defeated at Zhuque Floating Bridge.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，甯朔將軍徐元瑜以東府城降。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Pacifying-North General Xu Yuanyu surrendered Eastern Headquarters city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Pacifying-North General Xu Yuanyu surrendered Eastern Headquarters city.

sentences.zh: 青、冀二州刺史桓和入衛，屯東宮，尋亦降衍，於是閉宮城門自守。

translations.literal: Governors of Qing and Ji provinces Huan He entered to guard and garrisoned the Eastern Palace; soon he also surrendered to Yan — thereupon the palace city gates closed in self-defense.
translations.idiomatic: Governors of Qing and Ji provinces Huan He entered to guard and garrisoned the Eastern Palace; soon he also surrendered to Yan — thereupon the palace city gates closed in self-defense.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，新除雍州刺史王珍國、侍中張稷率兵入殿殺帝，時年十九。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on bingyin, newly appointed Governor of Yong Province Wang Zhenguo and Attendant-in-Ordinary Zhang Ji led troops into the hall and killed the emperor, aged nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on bingyin, newly appointed Governor of Yong Province Wang Zhenguo and Attendant-in-Ordinary Zhang Ji led troops into the hall and killed the emperor, aged nineteen.

sentences.zh: 帝在東宮，便好弄，不喜書學，明帝亦不以為非，但勖以家人之行，令太子求一日再入朝，發詔不許，使三日一朝。

translations.literal: While in the Eastern Palace he had loved play and disliked book-learning; Emperor Ming also did not consider it wrong, but urged family conduct — ordering the crown prince to seek entering court twice daily; edicts were not permitted — three days once.
translations.idiomatic: While in the Eastern Palace he had loved play and disliked book-learning; Emperor Ming also did not consider it wrong, but urged family conduct — ordering the crown prince to seek entering court twice daily; edicts were not permitted — three days once.

sentences.zh: 在宮嘗夜捕鼠達旦，以為笑樂。

translations.literal: Within the palace he once caught mice until dawn, taking it as laughter and pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: Within the palace he once caught mice until dawn, taking it as laughter and pleasure.

sentences.zh: 明帝臨崩，屬後事，以隆昌為戒，曰：「作事不可在人後。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming was near death he entrusted later affairs, taking Longchang as warning, saying, "In acting one must not be behind others."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming was near death he entrusted later affairs, taking Longchang as warning, saying, "In acting one must not be behind others."

sentences.zh: 」故委任群小，誅諸宰臣，無不如意。

translations.literal: " Therefore he entrusted petty men and executed various chief ministers — none not as wished.
translations.idiomatic: "Therefore he entrusted petty men and executed various chief ministers — none not as he wished.

sentences.zh: 性訥澀少言，不與朝士接。

translations.literal: By nature taciturn and slow of speech, he did not meet court gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: By nature taciturn and slow of speech, he did not meet court gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 欲速葬，惡靈在太極殿，徐孝嗣固爭，得踰月。

translations.literal: Wishing quick burial, he hated the coffin in the Grand Ultimate Hall; Xu Xiaosi firmly contended — over a month was obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Wishing quick burial, he hated the coffin in the Grand Ultimate Hall; Xu Xiaosi firmly contended — over a month was obtained.

sentences.zh: 每當哭，輒云喉痛。

translations.literal: Whenever mourning, he would say his throat hurt.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever mourning, he would say his throat hurt.

sentences.zh: 太中大夫羊闡入臨，無發，號慟俯仰，幘遂脫地，帝輟哭大笑，謂宦者王寶孫曰：「此謂禿鶖啼來乎。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Palace Attendants Yang Kan entered to mourn; without hair, wailing and bowing, his cap fell to the ground — the emperor stopped weeping and laughed greatly, telling eunuch Wang Baosun, "This is the bald vulture crying, is it?"
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of Palace Attendants Yang Kan entered to mourn; without hair, wailing and bowing, his cap fell to the ground — the emperor stopped weeping and laughed greatly, telling eunuch Wang Baosun, "This is the bald vulture crying, is it?"

sentences.zh: 」自江祏、始安王遙光等誅後，無所忌憚，日夜於後堂戲馬，鼓噪為樂。

translations.literal: After Jiang Shi, Prince of Shi'an Yaoguang and others were executed, he had no fear; day and night in the rear hall he played with horses, shouting and making music.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiang Shi, Prince of Shi'an Yaoguang and others were executed, he had no fear; day and night in the rear hall he played with horses, shouting and making music.

sentences.zh: 合夕，便擊金鼓吹角，令左右數百人叫，雜以羌胡橫吹諸伎。

translations.literal: At evening he would strike gold, blow horns and drums, ordering several hundred attendants to shout, mixed with Qiang and Hu horizontal pipes and various performers.
translations.idiomatic: At evening he would strike gold, blow horns and drums, ordering several hundred attendants to shout, mixed with Qiang and Hu horizontal pipes and various performers.

sentences.zh: 常以五更就臥，至晡乃起，王侯以下節朔朝見，晡後方前，或際暗遣出。

translations.literal: He constantly went to bed at the fifth watch and rose at afternoon; princes and officials down attended on festival days — only after afternoon did they advance, or at dusk were sent out.
translations.idiomatic: He constantly went to bed at the fifth watch and rose at afternoon; princes and officials down attended on festival days — only after afternoon did they advance, or at dusk were sent out.

sentences.zh: 台閣案奏，月數十日乃報，或不知所在。

translations.literal: Terrace pavilion memorials — several tens of days before reply, or whereabouts unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Terrace pavilion memorials — several tens of days passed before reply, or their whereabouts were unknown.

sentences.zh: 閹豎以紙包裹魚肉還家，並是五省黃案。

translations.literal: Eunuchs wrapped fish and meat in paper to take home — all were yellow documents of the five bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs wrapped fish and meat in paper to take home — all were yellow documents of the five bureaus.

sentences.zh: 二年元會，食後方出，朝賀裁竟，便還殿西序寢，自巳至申，百僚陪位，皆僵僕菜色。

translations.literal: At the second year's New Year assembly, he came out only after eating; when court congratulations barely ended, he returned to the western wing to sleep — from si to shen, officials standing in attendance all stiffened with ashen faces.
translations.idiomatic: At the second year's New Year assembly, he came out only after eating; when court congratulations barely ended, he returned to the western wing to sleep — from si to shen, officials standing in attendance all stiffened with ashen faces.

sentences.zh: 比起就會，匆遽而罷。

translations.literal: Rising to attend the assembly, he hurried and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Rising to attend the assembly, he hurried and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 太子所生母黃貴嬪早亡，令潘妃母養之。

translations.literal: The crown prince's birth-mother Lady Huang, Honored Consort, died early; Lady Pan was ordered to raise him.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's birth-mother Lady Huang, Honored Consort, died early; Lady Pan was ordered to raise him.

sentences.zh: 拜潘氏為貴妃，乘臥輿，帝騎馬從後，著織成褲褶，金薄帽，執七寶縛矟。

translations.literal: Lady Pan was honored as Honored Consort; riding a litter, the emperor on horseback followed behind, wearing woven trousers and jacket, gold-leaf cap, holding a seven-jewel bound spear.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Pan was honored as Honored Consort; riding a litter, the emperor on horseback followed behind, wearing woven trousers and jacket, gold-leaf cap, holding a seven-jewel bound spear.

sentences.zh: 又有金銀校具，錦繡諸帽數十種，各有名字。

translations.literal: Also gold and silver ornamental fittings, brocade caps of several tens of kinds — each had a name.
translations.idiomatic: Also gold and silver ornamental fittings, brocade caps of several tens of kinds — each had a name.

sentences.zh: 戎服急裝縛褲，上著絳衫，以為常服，不變寒暑。

translations.literal: Martial dress with urgent equipment and bound trousers, upper garment deep-red shirt — as regular dress, unchanged summer or winter.
translations.idiomatic: Martial dress with urgent equipment and bound trousers, upper garment deep-red shirt — as regular dress, unchanged summer or winter.

sentences.zh: 陵冒雨雪，不避坑阱。

translations.literal: He braved rain and snow, not avoiding pits and traps.
translations.idiomatic: He braved rain and snow, not avoiding pits and traps.

sentences.zh: 馳騁渴乏，輒下馬解取腰邊蠡器，酌水飲之，復上馳去。

translations.literal: Galloping until thirsty, he dismounted and took the gourd vessel at his waist, drank water, then remounted and galloped away.
translations.idiomatic: Galloping until thirsty, he dismounted and took the gourd vessel at his waist, drank water, then remounted and galloped away.

sentences.zh: 馬乘具用錦繡處，患為雨所濕，織雜采珠為覆蒙，備諸雕巧。

translations.literal: Where horse trappings used brocade, fearing rain would wet them, he wove multicolored beads as covering — every ornamental craft prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Where horse trappings used brocade, fearing rain would wet them, he wove multicolored beads as covering — every ornamental craft prepared.

sentences.zh: 教黃門五六十人為騎客，又選營署無賴小人善走者為逐馬鷹犬，左右數百人，常以自隨，奔走往來，略不暇息。

translations.literal: He trained fifty or sixty Yellow Gate men as riding guests; also selected worthless petty men from barracks and offices good at running as hawk-and-hound pursuers — several hundred attendants constantly followed, running back and forth, scarcely resting.
translations.idiomatic: He trained fifty or sixty Yellow Gate men as riding guests; also selected worthless petty men from barracks and offices good at running as hawk-and-hound pursuers — several hundred attendants constantly followed, running back and forth, scarcely resting.

sentences.zh: 置射雉場二百九十六處，翳中帷帳及步障，皆袷以綠紅錦，金銀鏤弩牙，毒瑁帖箭。

translations.literal: Two hundred ninety-six pheasant-shooting grounds were established; within the blinds, tents and screens and walking barriers were all lined with green and red brocade; gold and silver carved crossbow teeth, poisoned tortoise-shell arrow tips.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred ninety-six pheasant-shooting grounds were established; within the blinds, tents and screens and walking barriers were all lined with green and red brocade; gold and silver carved crossbow teeth, poisoned tortoise-shell arrow tips.

sentences.zh: 每出，輒與鷹犬隊主徐令孫、媒翳隊主俞靈韻齊馬而走，左右爭逐之。

translations.literal: Whenever going out, he galloped together with hawk-and-hound team leader Xu Lingsun and blind-layer team leader Yu Lingyun; attendants competed to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever going out, he galloped together with hawk-and-hound team leader Xu Lingsun and blind-layer team leader Yu Lingyun; attendants competed to pursue.

sentences.zh: 又甚有筋力，牽弓至三斛五斗。

translations.literal: Also he had great physical strength — drawing a bow to three hu five dou.
translations.idiomatic: Also he had great physical strength — drawing a bow to three hu five dou.

sentences.zh: 能擔幢，初學擔幢，每傾倒在幢杪者，必致踠傷。

translations.literal: He could bear a ceremonial pole; when first learning to bear a pole, each fall at the pole-top necessarily caused wrist injury.
translations.idiomatic: He could bear a ceremonial pole; when first learning to bear a pole, each fall at the pole-top necessarily caused wrist injury.

sentences.zh: 其後，白虎幢七丈五尺，齒上擔之，折齒不倦。

translations.literal: Afterward the white-tiger pole seven zhang five chi — he bore it on his teeth, breaking teeth without tiring.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the white-tiger pole seven zhang five chi — he bore it on his teeth, breaking teeth without tiring.

sentences.zh: 擔幢諸校具服飾，皆自製之，綴以金華玉鏡眾寶。

translations.literal: Pole-bearing various ceremonial fittings and clothing — all self-made, adorned with gold flowers, jade mirrors and many treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Pole-bearing various ceremonial fittings and clothing — all self-made, adorned with gold flowers, jade mirrors and many treasures.

sentences.zh: 舍人、主書及至左右主帥，並皆侍側，逞諸變態，曾無愧顏。

translations.literal: Attendants, chief scribes down to attendants and commanders — all attended at the side; displaying various transformations, never ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants, chief scribes down to attendants and commanders — all attended at the side; displaying various transformations, never ashamed.

sentences.zh: 始欲騎馬，未習其事，俞靈韻為作木馬，人在其中，行動進退，隨意所適，其後遂為善騎。

translations.literal: Wishing first to ride horses, not yet skilled — Yu Lingyun made a wooden horse; a man inside, moving forward and back as wished — afterward he became skilled at riding.
translations.idiomatic: Wishing first to ride horses, not yet skilled — Yu Lingyun made a wooden horse; a man inside, moving forward and back as wished — afterward he became skilled at riding.

sentences.zh: 陳顯達平，漸出遊走，不欲令人見之，驅斥百姓，唯置空宅而已。

translations.literal: After Chen Xianda was pacified, he gradually went out wandering, not wishing people to see; he drove off common people — only empty houses remained.
translations.idiomatic: After Chen Xianda was pacified, he gradually went out wandering, not wishing people to see; he drove off common people — only empty houses remained.

sentences.zh: 是時率一月二十餘出，既往無定處，尉司常慮得罪，東行驅西，南行驅北，應旦出，夜便驅逐，吏司奔驅，叫呼盈路。

translations.literal: At that time roughly twenty-plus outings per month; past and future had no fixed place; district officials constantly feared offense — going east they drove west, going south they drove north; if going out at dawn, at night they were already driven; clerks ran shouting, filling the roads.
translations.idiomatic: At that time roughly twenty-plus outings per month; past and future had no fixed place; district officials constantly feared offense — going east they drove west, going south they drove north; if going out at dawn, at night they were already driven; clerks ran shouting, filling the roads.

sentences.zh: 打鼓蹋圍，鼓聲所聞，便應奔走，臨時驅迫，衣不暇披，乃至徒跣走出，犯禁者應手格殺。

translations.literal: Beating drums and surrounding, wherever drum-sound was heard people had to run; temporarily driven, clothes had no time to be donned — even barefoot they ran out; violators were struck dead on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Beating drums and surrounding, wherever drum-sound was heard people had to run; temporarily driven, clothes had no time to be donned — even barefoot they ran out; violators were struck dead on the spot.

sentences.zh: 百姓無復作業，終日路隅。

translations.literal: Common people no longer worked; all day at the roadside.
translations.idiomatic: Common people no longer worked; all day at the roadside.

sentences.zh: 從萬春門由東宮以東至郊外，數十里，皆空家盡室。

translations.literal: From Wanchun Gate through the Eastern Palace east to the suburbs — several tens of li — all houses empty, families gone.
translations.idiomatic: From Wanchun Gate through the Eastern Palace east to the suburbs — several tens of li — all houses empty, families gone.

sentences.zh: 巷陌縣幔為高障，置人防守，謂之「屏除」。

translations.literal: Lanes and streets hung curtains as high barriers; men were posted to guard — called "screening removal."
translations.idiomatic: Lanes and streets hung curtains as high barriers; men were posted to guard — called screening removal.

sentences.zh: 高障之內，設部伍羽儀，復有數部，皆奏鼓吹羌胡伎，鼓角橫吹。

translations.literal: Within the high barriers, guard formations and feather insignia were set; also several sections, all playing martial pipes and Qiang-Hu performers, horns and horizontal pipes.
translations.idiomatic: Within the high barriers, guard formations and feather insignia were set; also several sections, all playing martial pipes and Qiang-Hu performers, horns and horizontal pipes.

sentences.zh: 夜反火光照天。

translations.literal: At night conversely firelight illuminated the sky.
translations.idiomatic: At night conversely firelight illuminated the sky.

sentences.zh: 每三四更中，鼓聲四出，幡戟橫路，百姓喧走，士庶莫辨。

translations.literal: Every three or four watches in the middle, drum-sounds issued in four directions; banners and halberds crossed the roads; common people shouted and ran; gentry and common could not distinguish.
translations.idiomatic: Every three or four watches in the middle, drum-sounds issued in four directions; banners and halberds crossed the roads; common people shouted and ran; gentry and common could not distinguish.

sentences.zh: 或於市肆左側過親幸家，環繞宛轉，周遍都下，老小震驚，啼號塞道。

translations.literal: Or passing favored persons' houses at the market left, circling and turning, traversing the whole capital — old and young shocked, crying filling the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Or passing favored persons' houses at the market left, circling and turning, traversing the whole capital — old and young shocked, crying filling the roads.

sentences.zh: 處處禁斷，不知所過。

translations.literal: Everywhere blocked — none knew where he passed.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere blocked — none knew where he passed.

sentences.zh: 疾患困篤者，悉扛移之。

translations.literal: Those ill and critically afflicted were all carried off.
translations.idiomatic: Those ill and critically afflicted were all carried off.

sentences.zh: 無人扛者，扶匐道側，吏司又加捶打，絕命者相系。

translations.literal: Those with none to carry them crawled at the roadside; clerks again beat them — the dead linked in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Those with none to carry them crawled at the roadside; clerks again beat them — the dead linked in succession.

sentences.zh: 從騎及左右因之入富家取物，無不蕩盡。

translations.literal: Following riders and attendants thereby entered rich families taking goods — none not entirely swept.
translations.idiomatic: Following riders and attendants thereby entered rich families taking goods — none not entirely swept.

sentences.zh: 工商莫不廢業，樵蘇由之路斷。

translations.literal: Merchants and craftsmen all ceased work; firewood-gathering routes were cut.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants and craftsmen all ceased work; firewood-gathering routes were cut.

sentences.zh: 至於乳婦昏姻之家，移產寄室，或輿病棄屍，不得殯葬。

translations.literal: Even wet-nurses' wedding households moved property to rented rooms, or carried the sick and abandoned corpses — could not bury.
translations.idiomatic: Even wet-nurses' wedding households moved property to rented rooms, or carried the sick and abandoned corpses — could not bury.

sentences.zh: 有棄病人于青溪邊者，吏懼為監司所問，推置水中，泥覆其面，須臾便死，遂失骸骨。

translations.literal: There were sick abandoned at Qing Stream edge; clerks fearing supervisors' inquiry pushed them into water, mud covering the face — in a moment dead; thus bones were lost.
translations.idiomatic: There were sick abandoned at Qing Stream edge; clerks fearing supervisors' inquiry pushed them into water, mud covering the face — in a moment dead; thus bones were lost.

sentences.zh: 前魏興太守王敬賓新死未斂，家人被驅，不得留視，及家人還，鼠食兩眼都盡。

translations.literal: Former Governor of Wei Prefecture Wang Jingbin had newly died unburied; family driven, could not remain to watch — when family returned, rats had eaten both eyes entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Former Governor of Wei Prefecture Wang Jingbin had newly died unburied; family driven, could not remain to watch — when family returned, rats had eaten both eyes entirely.

sentences.zh: 如此非一。

translations.literal: Such cases were not one.
translations.idiomatic: Such cases were not one.

sentences.zh: 又嘗至沈公城，有一婦人當產不去，帝入其家，問：「何獨在？

translations.literal: Also once going to Shen's Wall city, one woman about to give birth did not leave; the emperor entered her house, asking, "Why alone?"
translations.idiomatic: Also once going to Shen's Wall city, one woman about to give birth did not leave; the emperor entered her house, asking, "Why alone?"

sentences.zh: 」答曰：「臨產不得去。

translations.literal: " She answered, "About to give birth, cannot leave."
translations.idiomatic: "She answered, "About to give birth, cannot leave."

sentences.zh: 」因剖腹看男女。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he cut open her belly to see male or female.
translations.idiomatic: "Thereupon he cut open her belly to see male or female.

sentences.zh: 又長秋卿王儇病篤，不聽停家，死於路邊。

translations.literal: Also Chief of Long Autumn Wang Xuan critically ill — not permitted to stop at home; died at the roadside.
translations.idiomatic: Also Chief of Long Autumn Wang Xuan critically ill — not permitted to stop at home; died at the roadside.

sentences.zh: 丹陽尹王志被驅急，狼狽步走，惟將二門生自隨，藏朱雀航南酒壚中，夜方得羽儀而歸。

translations.literal: Governor of Danyang Wang Zhi was driven urgently, fleeing in disarray on foot — only two gate students followed, hiding in a wine shop south of Zhuque Floating Bridge; at night he obtained insignia and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Danyang Wang Zhi was driven urgently, fleeing in disarray on foot — only two gate students followed, hiding in a wine shop south of Zhuque Floating Bridge; at night he obtained insignia and returned.

sentences.zh: 喜遊獵，不避危險。

translations.literal: He loved hunting, not avoiding danger.
translations.idiomatic: He loved hunting, not avoiding danger.

sentences.zh: 至蔣山定林寺，一沙門病不能去，藏於草間，為軍人所得，應時殺之。

translations.literal: Reaching Dinglin Temple on Zhong Mountain, one monk ill could not leave, hiding in grass — seized by soldiers and killed on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Dinglin Temple on Zhong Mountain, one monk ill could not leave, hiding in grass — seized by soldiers and killed on the spot.

sentences.zh: 左右韓暉光曰：「老道人可念。

translations.literal: Attendant Han Huiguang said, "Old monk is pitiable."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Han Huiguang said, "Old monk is pitiable."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「汝見獐鹿亦不射邪？

translations.literal: " The emperor said, "You see deer also and do not shoot?"
translations.idiomatic: "The emperor said, "You see deer also and do not shoot?"

sentences.zh: 」仍百箭俱發。

translations.literal: " Thereupon a hundred arrows all released.
translations.idiomatic: "Thereupon a hundred arrows all released.

sentences.zh: 故貴人富室者，皆數處立宅，以為避圍之舍。

translations.literal: Therefore honored persons and rich families all established dwellings in several places as escape enclosures.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore honored persons and rich families all established dwellings in several places as escape enclosures.

sentences.zh: 每還宮，常至三更，百姓然後得反。

translations.literal: Whenever returning to the palace, constantly until the third watch — then common people could return.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever returning to the palace, constantly until the third watch — only then could common people return.

sentences.zh: 禁斷又不即通，處處屯咽，或泥塗灌注，或冰凍嚴結，老幼啼號，不可聞見。

translations.literal: Blockades also did not immediately open — everywhere congested; some mud poured, some frozen solid — old and young cried, unbearable to hear or see.
translations.idiomatic: Blockades also did not immediately open — everywhere congested; some mud poured, some frozen solid — old and young cried, unbearable to hear or see.

sentences.zh: 時人以其所圍處號為「長圍」。

translations.literal: People of the time called the places he surrounded "Long Enclosure."
translations.idiomatic: People of the time called the places he surrounded Long Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 及建康城見圍，亦名長圍，識者以為讖焉。

translations.literal: When Jianye city was besieged, it was also named Long Enclosure — observers considered it an omen.
translations.idiomatic: When Jianye city was besieged, it was also named Long Enclosure — observers considered it an omen.

sentences.zh: 三年，殿內火，合夕便發，其時帝猶未還，宮內諸房合已閉，內人不得出，外人又不敢輒開，比及開，死者相枕。

translations.literal: In the third year, fire within the hall — at evening it broke out; the emperor had not yet returned; inner palace rooms were already closed — inner people could not exit, outer people dared not open — by the time opened, the dead lay pillow to pillow.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, fire within the hall — at evening it broke out; the emperor had not yet returned; inner palace rooms were already closed — inner people could not exit, outer people dared not open — by the time opened, the dead lay pillow to pillow.

sentences.zh: 領軍將軍王瑩率眾救火，太極殿得全。

translations.literal: Commandant of the Guards Wang Ying led troops to fight fire; the Grand Ultimate Hall was entirely preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant of the Guards Wang Ying led troops to fight fire; the Grand Ultimate Hall was entirely preserved.

sentences.zh: 內外叫喚，聲動天地。

translations.literal: Inner and outer shouting shook heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer shouting shook heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 帝三更中方還，先至東宮，慮有亂，不敢便入，參覘審無異，乃歸。

translations.literal: The emperor returned only at the third watch — first to the Eastern Palace, fearing disorder, dared not enter; observing and finding no anomaly, then returned.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned only at the third watch — first to the Eastern Palace, fearing disorder, dared not enter; observing and finding no anomaly, then returned.

sentences.zh: 其後出遊，火又燒璿儀、曜靈等十餘殿及柏寢，北至華林，西至秘閣，三千餘間皆盡。

translations.literal: Afterward going out wandering, fire again burned Xuanyi, Yaoling and more than ten halls and cypress sleeping chambers — north to Hualin, west to the Secret Archive — more than three thousand rooms all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward going out wandering, fire again burned Xuanyi, Yaoling and more than ten halls and cypress sleeping chambers — north to Hualin, west to the Secret Archive — more than three thousand rooms all destroyed.

sentences.zh: 左右趙鬼能讀西京賦，云：「柏梁既災，建章是營」。

translations.literal: Attendant Zhao Gui could read Western Capital Rhapsody, saying, "After Bolang calamity, Jianzhang was built."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Zhao Gui could read Western Capital Rhapsody, saying, "After Bolang calamity, Jianzhang was built."

sentences.zh: 於是大起諸殿，芳樂、芳德、仙華、大興、含德、清曜、安壽等殿，又別為潘妃起神仙、永壽、玉壽三殿，皆匝飾以金璧。

translations.literal: Thereupon great halls were raised — Fangle, Fangde, Xianhua, Daxing, Hede, Qingyao, Anshou and others; also separately for Lady Pan, Immortal, Yongshou and Yushou three halls — all encircled adorned with gold and jade.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon great halls were raised — Fangle, Fangde, Xianhua, Daxing, Hede, Qingyao, Anshou and others; also separately for Lady Pan, Immortal, Yongshou and Yushou three halls — all encircled and adorned with gold and jade.

sentences.zh: 其玉壽中作飛仙帳，四面繡綺，窗間盡畫神仙。

translations.literal: Within Yushou a flying-immortal canopy was made; four sides embroidered brocade; between windows all painted immortals.
translations.idiomatic: Within Yushou a flying-immortal canopy was made; four sides embroidered brocade; between windows all painted immortals.

sentences.zh: 又作七賢，皆以美女侍側。

translations.literal: Also the Seven Worthies — all with beautiful women attending at the side.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Seven Worthies — all with beautiful women attending at the side.

sentences.zh: 鑿金銀為書字，靈獸、神禽、風雲、華炬，為之玩飾。

translations.literal: Gold and silver carved as written characters; spirit beasts, divine birds, wind clouds, flowering torches — as ornamental playthings.
translations.idiomatic: Gold and silver carved as written characters; spirit beasts, divine birds, wind clouds, flowering torches — as ornamental playthings.

sentences.zh: 椽桷之端，悉垂鈴佩。

translations.literal: At rafter ends all hung bells and pendants.
translations.idiomatic: At rafter ends all hung bells and pendants.

sentences.zh: 江左舊物，有古玉律數枚，悉裁以鈿笛。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital old objects had several ancient jade pitch-pipes — all cut for inlaid flutes.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Capital old objects had several ancient jade pitch-pipes — all cut for inlaid flutes.

sentences.zh: 莊嚴寺有玉九子鈴，外國寺佛面有光相，禪靈寺塔諸寶珥，皆剝取以施潘妃殿飾。

translations.literal: Zhuangyan Temple had jade nine-son bells; foreign temple Buddha faces had halos; Chanling Temple tower many jewel earrings — all stripped to adorn Lady Pan's hall.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangyan Temple had jade nine-son bells; foreign temple Buddha faces had halos; Chanling Temple tower many jewel earrings — all stripped to adorn Lady Pan's hall.

sentences.zh: 性急暴，所作便欲速成，造殿未施梁桷，便於地畫之，唯須宏麗，不知精密。

translations.literal: By nature urgent and violent, what he made had to be quickly completed; before hall beams and rafters were placed, he drew on the ground — only seeking magnificence, not knowing precision.
translations.idiomatic: By nature urgent and violent, what he made had to be quickly completed; before hall beams and rafters were placed, he drew on the ground — only seeking magnificence, not knowing precision.

translations.literal: He could not distinguish painting — only took dazzling brilliance; therefore craftsmen relied on this not to exert effort.
translations.idiomatic: He could not distinguish painting — only took dazzling brilliance; therefore craftsmen relied on this not to exert effort.

sentences.zh: 又鑿金為蓮華以帖地，令潘妃行其上，曰：「此步步生蓮華也。

translations.literal: Also gold was carved as lotus flowers pasted on the ground; Lady Pan walked upon them, saying, "This is step by step lotus flowers born."
translations.idiomatic: Also gold was carved as lotus flowers pasted on the ground; Lady Pan walked upon them, saying, "This is step by step lotus flowers born."

sentences.zh: 」塗壁皆以麝香，錦幔珠簾，窮極綺麗。

translations.literal: " Walls were coated with musk; brocade curtains and pearl blinds — ultimate brocade splendor.
translations.idiomatic: "Walls were coated with musk; brocade curtains and pearl blinds — ultimate brocade splendor.

sentences.zh: 縶役工匠，自夜達曉，猶不副速，乃剔取諸寺佛刹殿藻井、仙人、騎獸以充足之。

translations.literal: Conscripting craftsmen from night to dawn still did not meet speed — then stripped Buddhist temple hall ceiling wells, immortals and riding beasts to fill the need.
translations.idiomatic: Conscripting craftsmen from night to dawn still did not meet speed — then stripped Buddhist temple hall ceiling wells, immortals and riding beasts to fill the need.

sentences.zh: 武帝興光樓上施青漆，世人謂之「青樓」，帝曰：「武帝不巧，何不純用琉璃。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu's Xingguang Tower was coated with green lacquer — people called it "Green Tower"; the emperor said, "Emperor Wu not clever — why not purely use glass?"
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu's Xingguang Tower was coated with green lacquer — people called it Green Tower; the emperor said, "Emperor Wu not clever — why not purely use glass?"

sentences.zh: 」潘氏服御，極選珍寶，主衣庫舊物，不復周用，貴市人間金銀寶物，價皆數倍，虎珀釧一隻，直百七十萬。

translations.literal: " Lady Pan's clothing and fittings — extremely selected treasures; robe treasury old objects no longer sufficed; expensively buying common people's gold and silver treasures — prices all several times; one amber bracelet straight one million seven hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: "Lady Pan's clothing and fittings — extremely selected treasures; robe treasury old objects no longer sufficed; expensively buying common people's gold and silver treasures — prices all several times; one amber bracelet worth one million seven hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 都下酒租，皆折輸金，以供雜用。

translations.literal: Capital wine tax — all converted to gold payment for miscellaneous use.
translations.idiomatic: Capital wine tax — all converted to gold payment for miscellaneous use.

sentences.zh: 猶不能足，下揚、南徐二州橋桁塘埭丁計功為直，斂取見錢，供太樂主衣雜費。

translations.literal: Still not enough — lower Yang and South Xu two provinces' bridge beams and dam corvée labor calculated as value, collecting cash on the spot for Grand Music, robe treasury and miscellaneous expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Still not enough — lower Yang and South Xu two provinces' bridge beams and dam corvée labor calculated as value, collecting cash on the spot for Grand Music, robe treasury and miscellaneous expenses.

sentences.zh: 由是所在塘瀆，悉皆隳廢。

translations.literal: Whereupon everywhere ponds and ditches were all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Whereupon everywhere ponds and ditches were all destroyed.

sentences.zh: 又訂出雄雉頭、鶴氅、白鷺縗，百品千條，無復窮已。

translations.literal: Also specified male pheasant heads, crane cloaks, white egret mourning — a hundred kinds, a thousand items, without end.
translations.idiomatic: Also specified male pheasant heads, crane cloaks, white egret mourning — a hundred kinds, a thousand items, without end.

sentences.zh: 親幸小人，因緣為奸，科一輸十。

translations.literal: Favored petty men by opportunity committed fraud — one item levied as ten.
translations.idiomatic: Favored petty men by opportunity committed fraud — one item levied as ten.

sentences.zh: 又各就州縣求為人輸，准取見直，不為輸送。

translations.literal: Also each at provinces and counties sought to be delivery agents — taking cash on the spot, not making delivery.
translations.idiomatic: Also each at provinces and counties sought to be delivery agents — taking cash on the spot, not making delivery.

sentences.zh: 守宰懼威，口不得道，須物之處，以復重求。

translations.literal: Magistrates and chiefs fearing authority could not speak — where items were needed, again demanded doubly.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates and chiefs fearing authority could not speak — where items were needed, again demanded doubly.

sentences.zh: 如此相仍，前後不息，百姓困盡，號泣道路。

translations.literal: Thus continuing without cease — common people exhausted, crying on the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Thus continuing without cease — common people exhausted, crying on the roads.

sentences.zh: 少府太官，凡諸市買，事皆急速，催求相系。

translations.literal: Director of Palace Supplies and Grand Kitchen — all market purchases, affairs all urgent; demands linked in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Palace Supplies and Grand Kitchen — all market purchases, affairs all urgent; demands linked in succession.

sentences.zh: 吏司賓士，遇便虜奪，市廛離散，商旅靡依。

translations.literal: Clerks and guest gentlemen, meeting opportunity plundered; markets scattered; merchants and travelers had no support.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks and guest gentlemen, meeting opportunity plundered; markets scattered; merchants and travelers had no support.

sentences.zh: 又以閱武堂為芳樂苑，窮奇極麗。

translations.literal: Also Review Troops Hall was made Fragrant Music Park — ultimate strangeness and splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Also Review Troops Hall was made Fragrant Music Park — ultimate strangeness and splendor.

sentences.zh: 當暑種樹，朝種夕死，死而復種，率無一生。

translations.literal: In summer heat trees were planted — planted in morning, dead by evening; dead then replanted — none survived.
translations.idiomatic: In summer heat trees were planted — planted in morning, dead by evening; dead then replanted — none survived.

sentences.zh: 於是徵求人家，望樹便取，毀徹牆屋，以移置之。

translations.literal: Thereupon demanding people's houses — seeing trees they took; destroying walls and houses to transplant.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon demanding people's houses — seeing trees they took; destroying walls and houses to transplant.

sentences.zh: 大樹合抱，亦皆移掘，插葉系華，取玩俄頃。

translations.literal: Large trees arms-spanning — also all moved and dug; tied leaves and attached flowers for momentary viewing.
translations.idiomatic: Large trees arms-spanning — also all moved and dug; tied leaves and attached flowers for momentary viewing.

sentences.zh: 劃取細草，來植階庭，烈日之日，至便焦燥。

translations.literal: Cutting fine grass to plant on steps and courtyard — on blazing sun days, immediately scorched dry.
translations.idiomatic: Cutting fine grass to plant on steps and courtyard — on blazing sun days, immediately scorched dry.

sentences.zh: 紛紜往還，無復已極。

translations.literal: Coming and going in confusion — without end.
translations.idiomatic: Coming and going in confusion — without end.

sentences.zh: 山石皆塗以采色，跨池水立紫閣諸樓，壁上畫男女私褻之像。

translations.literal: Mountain rocks all coated with colors; spanning pond water stood purple pavilions and various towers; walls painted men and women in private obscenity.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain rocks all coated with colors; spanning pond water stood purple pavilions and various towers; walls painted men and women in private obscenity.

sentences.zh: 明帝時多聚金寶，至是金以為泥，不足周用，令富室賣金，不問多少，限以賤價，又不還直。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming's time gathered much gold and treasure — now gold as mud still insufficient; ordering rich households to sell gold regardless of amount, limited to low price, also not repaying value.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming's time gathered much gold and treasure — now gold as mud still insufficient; ordering rich households to sell gold regardless of amount, limited to low price, also not repaying value.

sentences.zh: 張欣泰嘗謂舍人裴長穆曰：「宮殿何事頓爾！

translations.literal: Zhang Xintai once told Attendant Pei Changmu, "Palace halls — why suddenly thus!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xintai once told Attendant Pei Changmu, "Palace halls — why suddenly thus!"

sentences.zh: 夫以秦之富，起一阿房而滅，今不及秦一郡，而頓起數十阿房，其危殆矣。

translations.literal: With Qin's wealth, one Epang was raised and it perished — now not reaching one Qin commandery, yet suddenly raising several tens of Epang — the danger is near."
translations.idiomatic: With Qin's wealth, one Epang was raised and it perished — now not reaching one Qin commandery, yet suddenly raising several tens of Epang — the danger is near."

sentences.zh: 」答曰：「非不悅子之道，顧言不用耳。」

translations.literal: " He answered, "Not displeased with your way — but words are not used."
translations.idiomatic: "He answered, "Not displeased with your way — but words are not used."

sentences.zh: 潘妃放恣，威行遠近。

translations.literal: Lady Pan acted unrestrained; authority extended far and near.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Pan acted unrestrained; authority extended far and near.

sentences.zh: 父寶慶與諸小共逞奸毒，富人悉誣為罪，田宅貲財，莫不啟乞。

translations.literal: Father Baoqing with various petty men together exercised wicked poison; rich people all falsely accused of crime — fields, houses, property, none not petitioned and seized.
translations.idiomatic: Father Baoqing with various petty men together exercised wicked poison; rich people all falsely accused of crime — fields, houses, property, none not petitioned and seized.

sentences.zh: 或云寄附隱藏，復加收沒，計一家見陷，禍及親鄰。

translations.literal: Or saying entrusted hidden storage — again added confiscation; calculating one family's ruin, disaster reached kin and neighbors.
translations.idiomatic: Or saying entrusted hidden storage — again added confiscation; calculating one family's ruin, disaster reached kin and neighbors.

sentences.zh: 又慮後患，男口必殺。

translations.literal: Also fearing later trouble — male mouths must be killed.
translations.idiomatic: Also fearing later trouble — male mouths must be killed.

sentences.zh: 明帝之崩，竟不一日蔬食，居處衣服，無改平常。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming died, not one day of vegetable food; dwelling and clothing unchanged from ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming died, not one day of vegetable food; dwelling and clothing unchanged from ordinary.

sentences.zh: 潘妃生女，百日而亡，制斬衰絰杖，衣悉粗布。

translations.literal: When Lady Pan bore a daughter, at a hundred days she died — regulations of severest mourning with staff; clothing all coarse cloth.
translations.idiomatic: When Lady Pan bore a daughter, at a hundred days she died — regulations of severest mourning with staff; clothing all coarse cloth.

sentences.zh: 群小來吊，盤旋地坐，舉手受執蔬膳，積旬不聽音伎。

translations.literal: Petty men came to mourn, circling sitting on the ground, raising hands receiving held vegetable meals — several ten days no music heard.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men came to mourn, circling sitting on the ground, raising hands receiving held vegetable meals — several ten days no music heard.

sentences.zh: 左右直長閹豎王寶孫諸人，共營肴羞，雲為天子解菜。

translations.literal: Attendants Direct Chief eunuchs Wang Baosun and others together prepared delicacies, saying to relieve the Son of Heaven's abstinence.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants Direct Chief eunuchs Wang Baosun and others together prepared delicacies, saying to relieve the Son of Heaven's abstinence.

sentences.zh: 又于苑中立店肆，模大市，日遊市中，雜所貨物，與宮人閹豎共為裨販。

translations.literal: Also within the park shops were established, modeled on the great market — daily wandering the market, mixed goods, with palace women and eunuchs together as petty traders.
translations.idiomatic: Also within the park shops were established, modeled on the great market — daily wandering the market, mixed goods, with palace women and eunuchs together as petty traders.

sentences.zh: 以潘妃為市令，自為市吏錄事，將鬥者就潘妃罰之。

translations.literal: Lady Pan as market magistrate; himself as market clerk recorder; those about to fight were sent to Lady Pan for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Pan as market magistrate; himself as market clerk recorder; those about to fight were sent to Lady Pan for punishment.

sentences.zh: 帝小有得失，潘則與杖，乃敕虎賁威儀不得進大荊子，合內不得進實中荻。

translations.literal: The emperor had small gains and losses — Lady Pan then beat him with a staff; he ordered tiger guards ceremonial guard not to advance large thorn staff; within the chambers not to advance solid-center reed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had small gains and losses — Lady Pan then beat him with a staff; he ordered tiger guards ceremonial guard not to advance large thorn staff; within the chambers not to advance solid-center reed.

translations.literal: Though fearing Lady Pan, secretly he committed adultery with various sisters.
translations.idiomatic: Though fearing Lady Pan, secretly he committed adultery with various sisters.

sentences.zh: 每游走，潘氏乘小輿，宮人皆露褌，著綠絲屩，帝自戎服騎馬從後。

translations.literal: Whenever wandering, Lady Pan rode a small litter; palace women all exposed drawers, wearing green silk shoes; the emperor in martial dress on horseback followed behind.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever wandering, Lady Pan rode a small litter; palace women all exposed drawers, wearing green silk shoes; the emperor in martial dress on horseback followed behind.

sentences.zh: 又開渠立埭，躬自引船，埭上設店，坐而屠肉。

translations.literal: Also opened channels and established dams; personally pulled boats; on the dam shops were set — sitting butchering meat.
translations.idiomatic: Also opened channels and established dams; personally pulled boats; on the dam shops were set — sitting butchering meat.

translations.idiomatic: At that time common people sang, "Review Troops Hall, plant willows — Son of Heaven butchers meat, Lady Pan sells wine."

translations.literal: Also he particularly believed in Lord Jiang spirit — welcomed into the palace, day and night praying.
translations.idiomatic: Also he particularly believed in Lord Jiang spirit — welcomed into the palace, day and night praying.

sentences.zh: 左右朱光尚詐云見神，動輒諮啟，並雲降福。

translations.literal: Attendant Zhu Guangshang falsely claimed seeing the spirit — whenever consulted and reported, all said blessings descended.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Zhu Guangshang falsely claimed seeing the spirit — whenever consulted and reported, all said blessings descended.

translations.idiomatic: After Shi'an was pacified, he added rank of Chancellor; finally also titled Spirit Emperor — carriage robes and feather insignia all followed kings.

translations.literal: Also he particularly believed small shrines — daily several tens; shamans and witch old women, welcoming and sending off in confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Also he particularly believed small shrines — daily several tens; shamans and witch old women, welcoming and sending off in confusion.

translations.literal: Guangshang always claimed the spirit's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshang always claimed the spirit's intent.

translations.literal: Fan Yun told Guangshang, "You are the Son of Heaven's essential man — should think of plans entirely safe."
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yun told Guangshang, "You are the Son of Heaven's essential man — should think of plans entirely safe."

sentences.zh: 」光尚曰：「至尊不可諫正，當托鬼神以達意耳。

translations.idiomatic: "Guangshang said, "The Son of Heaven cannot be remonstrated straight — should entrust ghosts and spirits to convey intent."

translations.literal: " Later going east to Leyou, men and horses suddenly startled — asking Guangshang, Guangshang said, "Just now saw the late emperor greatly angry — does not permit frequent going out."
translations.idiomatic: "Later going east to Leyou, men and horses suddenly startled — asking Guangshang, Guangshang said, "Just now saw the late emperor greatly angry — does not permit frequent going out."

translations.literal: " The emperor greatly angry, drew knife with Guangxiang and others to search — finding no place, bound rush as Emperor Ming's form, facing north beheaded, head hung at park gate.
translations.idiomatic: "The emperor greatly angry, drew knife with Guangxiang and others to search — finding no place, bound rush as Emperor Ming's form, facing north beheaded, head hung at park gate.
