translations.literal: From Yongyuan afterward, whenever Wei came to attack, followed by internal troubles — Yang and South Xu two provinces' human corvée, three men two taken — this as rate.
translations.idiomatic: From Yongyuan afterward, whenever Wei came to attack, followed by internal troubles — Yang and South Xu two provinces' human corvée, three men two taken — this as rate.

sentences.zh: 遠郡悉令上米准行，一人五十斛，輸米既畢，就役如故。

translations.literal: Distant commanderies all ordered to deliver rice at standard — one man fifty hu; when rice delivery complete, corvée as before.
translations.idiomatic: Distant commanderies all ordered to deliver rice at standard — one man fifty hu; when rice delivery complete, corvée as before.

sentences.zh: 又先是諸郡役人，多依人士為附隸，謂之「屬名」。

translations.literal: Also previously various commanderies' corvée laborers mostly relied on gentlemen as attached registry — called "attached names."
translations.idiomatic: Also previously various commanderies' corvée laborers mostly relied on gentlemen as attached registry — called attached names.

sentences.zh: 又東境役苦，百姓多注籍詐病，遣外醫巫，在所檢占諸屬名，並取病身。

translations.literal: Also eastern territories' corvée bitter — common people mostly registered falsely ill; sent outside medical shamans — wherever inspected all attached names, all took sick bodies.
translations.idiomatic: Also eastern territories' corvée bitter — common people mostly registered falsely ill; sent outside medical shamans — wherever inspected all attached names, all took sick bodies.

sentences.zh: 凡屬名多不合役，止避小小假，並是役蔭之家。

translations.literal: All attached names mostly did not fit corvée — only avoided small leaves; all were corvée-shield households.
translations.idiomatic: All attached names mostly did not fit corvée — only avoided small leaves; all were corvée-shield households.

sentences.zh: 凡注病者，或已積年，皆攝充將役。

translations.literal: All who registered illness — some already accumulated years — all seized to fill soldier corvée.
translations.idiomatic: All who registered illness — some already accumulated years — all seized to fill soldier corvée.

sentences.zh: 又追責病者租布，隨其年歲多少。

translations.literal: Also pursued collecting sick persons' rent and cloth according to years more or less.
translations.idiomatic: Also pursued collecting sick persons' rent and cloth according to years more or less.

sentences.zh: 銜命之人，皆給貨賂，隨意縱舍。

translations.literal: Those bearing orders — all given bribes; as wished released or retained.
translations.idiomatic: Those bearing orders — all given bribes; as wished released or retained.

sentences.zh: 又橫調徵求，皆出百姓。

translations.literal: Also arbitrary adjustments and demands — all came from common people.
translations.idiomatic: Also arbitrary adjustments and demands — all came from common people.

sentences.zh: 群小以陳顯達下數日便敗，崔慧景圍城正得十日，及蕭衍師至，亦謂為然。

translations.literal: Petty men because Chen Xianda within several days was defeated, Cui Huijing besieging the city exactly ten days, and when Xiao Yan's army arrived also considered it so.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men because Chen Xianda within several days was defeated, Cui Huijing besieging the city exactly ten days, and when Xiao Yan's army arrived also considered it so.

sentences.zh: 裹糧食、樵芻，凡所須物，為百日備。

translations.literal: Wrapped grain food, firewood and fodder — all needed items prepared for a hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: Wrapped grain food, firewood and fodder — all needed items prepared for a hundred days.

sentences.zh: 帝謂茹法珍曰：「須來至白門前，當一決。

translations.literal: The emperor told Ru Fazhen, "Need only come to White Gate front — then one decisive battle."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Ru Fazhen, "Need only come to White Gate front — then one decisive battle."

sentences.zh: 」及至近郊，乃聚兵為固守計，召王侯分置尚書都坐及殿省。

translations.literal: " When reaching near suburbs, then gathered troops for firm-defense plan; summoned princes assigned to Masters of Writing conference seats and hall offices.
translations.idiomatic: "When reaching near suburbs, then gathered troops for firm-defense plan; summoned princes assigned to Masters of Writing conference seats and hall offices.

sentences.zh: 尚書舊事，悉充紙鎧。

translations.literal: Masters of Writing old affairs — all filled paper armor.
translations.idiomatic: Masters of Writing old affairs — all filled paper armor.

sentences.zh: 使冠軍將軍王珍國領三萬人據大桁，莫有鬥志，遣王寶孫督戰，呼為王倀子。

translations.literal: Ordered Champion General Wang Zhenguo to lead thirty thousand men holding the Great Bridge — none had fighting will; dispatched Wang Baosun to supervise battle, calling him Wang Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered Champion General Wang Zhenguo to lead thirty thousand men holding the Great Bridge — none had fighting will; dispatched Wang Baosun to supervise battle, calling him Wang Tutor.

sentences.zh: 寶孫切罵諸將帥，直合將軍席豪發憤突陣死。

translations.literal: Baosun bitterly cursed various generals; Direct Attendant General Xi Hao in anger charged the formation and died.
translations.idiomatic: Baosun bitterly cursed various generals; Direct Attendant General Xi Hao in anger charged the formation and died.

sentences.zh: 豪，驍將也，既斃，眾軍於是土崩。

translations.literal: Hao was a fierce general; once killed, the mass of armies then collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Hao was a fierce general; once killed, the mass of armies then collapsed.

sentences.zh: 軍人從朱雀觀上自投及赴淮水死者無數。

translations.literal: Soldiers from Zhuque Watch tower threw themselves and rushed to the Huai River — the dead countless.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers from Zhuque Watch tower threw themselves and rushed to the Huai River — the dead countless.

sentences.zh: 於是閉城自守，城內軍事委王珍國。

translations.literal: Thereupon closed the city in self-defense; within-city military affairs entrusted to Wang Zhenguo.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon closed the city in self-defense; within-city military affairs entrusted to Wang Zhenguo.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史張稷入衛，以稷為副，實甲猶七萬人。

translations.literal: Governor of Yan Province Zhang Ji entered to guard; Ji made deputy — solid armor still seventy thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Yan Province Zhang Ji entered to guard; Ji made deputy — solid armor still seventy thousand men.

sentences.zh: 帝著烏帽褲褶，備羽儀，登南掖門臨望。

translations.literal: The emperor wore black cap and trousers-jacket, complete feather insignia, ascended South Flank Gate to observe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore black cap and trousers-jacket, complete feather insignia, ascended South Flank Gate to observe.

sentences.zh: 又虛設鎧馬齋仗千人，皆張弓拔白，出東掖門，稱蔣王出蕩。

translations.literal: Also falsely set armored horses and ceremonial weapons a thousand men — all drew bows and pulled white, exiting East Flank Gate, claiming Lord Jiang going out to drive.
translations.idiomatic: Also falsely set armored horses and ceremonial weapons a thousand men — all drew bows and pulled white, exiting East Flank Gate, claiming Lord Jiang going out to drive.

sentences.zh: 又受刀敕等教著五音兒衣，登城望戰。

translations.literal: Also received knife-edict and others teaching wearing five-tone child clothes, ascending the wall to observe battle.
translations.idiomatic: Also received knife-edict and others teaching wearing five-tone child clothes, ascending the wall to observe battle.

sentences.zh: 還與禦刀左右及六宮于華光殿立軍壘，以金玉為鎧仗，親自臨陣，詐被創勢，以板扛將去，以此厭勝。

translations.literal: Returning with Imperial Knife attendants and six palaces at Huaguang Hall established military ramparts — jade and gold as armor and weapons; personally facing the formation, falsely wounded posture — carried off on a board, thus counter-magic.
translations.idiomatic: Returning with Imperial Knife attendants and six palaces at Huaguang Hall established military ramparts — jade and gold as armor and weapons; personally facing the formation, falsely wounded posture — carried off on a board, thus counter-magic.

sentences.zh: 又于閱武堂設牙門軍頓，每夜嚴警。

translations.literal: Also at Review Troops Hall set gate-teeth military encampment — nightly strict alert.
translations.idiomatic: Also at Review Troops Hall set gate-teeth military encampment — nightly strict alert.

sentences.zh: 帝於殿內騎馬，從鳳莊門入徽明門，馬被銀蓮葉具裝鎧，雜羽孔翠寄生，逐馬左右衛從，晝眠夜起如平常。

translations.literal: The emperor within the hall rode horses — from Phoenix Village Gate entering Huiming Gate; horses wore silver lotus-leaf complete armor, mixed feathers peacock parasitic; following horse left and right guards; day sleep night rise as ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor within the hall rode horses — from Phoenix Village Gate entering Huiming Gate; horses wore silver lotus-leaf complete armor, mixed feathers peacock parasitic; following horse left and right guards; day sleep night rise as ordinary.

sentences.zh: 聞外鼓吹叫聲，被大紅袍，登景陽樓望，弩幾中之。

translations.literal: Hearing outside martial pipes shouting — put on great red robe, ascended Jingyang Tower to observe; crossbow nearly hit.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing outside martial pipes shouting — put on great red robe, ascended Jingyang Tower to observe; crossbow nearly hit.

sentences.zh: 眾皆怠怨，不為致力，募兵出戰，至城門數十步，皆坐甲而歸。

translations.literal: The mass all slackened and resented, not exerting effort; recruiting soldiers to exit battle — reaching gate several tens of steps, all sat armor and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The mass all slackened and resented, not exerting effort; recruiting soldiers to exit battle — reaching gate several tens of steps, all sat armor and returned.

sentences.zh: 慮城外有伏兵，乃燒城傍諸府署，六門之內皆盡。

translations.literal: Fearing ambush outside the city, burned various offices beside the city — within the six gates all exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing ambush outside the city, burned various offices beside the city — within the six gates all exhausted.

sentences.zh: 城中閣道、西掖門內，相聚為市，販死牛馬肉。

translations.literal: Within the city covered ways and West Flank Gate inside gathered as market — selling dead ox and horse meat.
translations.idiomatic: Within the city covered ways and West Flank Gate inside gathered as market — selling dead ox and horse meat.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍長圍既立，塹柵嚴固，然後出蕩，屢戰不捷。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's Long Enclosure already established — moat palisade strict and solid — then he went out to drive; repeatedly battled without success.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan's Long Enclosure already established — moat palisade strict and solid — then he went out to drive; repeatedly battled without success.

sentences.zh: 帝尤惜金錢，不肯賞賜，茹法珍叩頭請之，帝曰：「賊來獨取我邪，何為就我求物？

translations.literal: The emperor especially treasured money, unwilling to bestow rewards; Ru Fazhen kowtowed requesting — the emperor said, "Rebels come only to take me — why come to me seeking things?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor especially treasured money, unwilling to bestow rewards; Ru Fazhen kowtowed requesting — the emperor said, "Rebels come only to take me — why come to me seeking things?"

sentences.zh: 」後堂儲數百具榜，啟為城防，帝曰：「擬作殿。

translations.literal: " Rear hall stored several hundred sets of boards — memorialized for city defense — the emperor said, "Intend to make halls."
translations.idiomatic: "Rear hall stored several hundred sets of boards — memorialized for city defense — the emperor said, "Intend to make halls."

sentences.zh: 」竟不與。

translations.literal: " In the end not given.
translations.idiomatic: "In the end not given.

sentences.zh: 城防巧手，而悉令作殿，晝夜不休。

translations.literal: City-defense skilled craftsmen — all ordered to make halls; day and night without rest.
translations.idiomatic: City-defense skilled craftsmen — all ordered to make halls; day and night without rest.

sentences.zh: 又催禦府細作三百人精仗，須圍解以擬屏除。

translations.literal: Also urgently demanded Imperial Workshop fine craftsmen three hundred men refined weapons — needing siege lifted to intend screening removal.
translations.idiomatic: Also urgently demanded Imperial Workshop fine craftsmen three hundred men refined weapons — needing siege lifted to intend screening removal.

sentences.zh: 金銀雕鏤雜物，倍急於常。

translations.literal: Gold and silver carved miscellaneous objects — doubly urgent as usual.
translations.idiomatic: Gold and silver carved miscellaneous objects — doubly urgent as usual.

sentences.zh: 法珍、蟲兒又說帝曰：「大臣不留意，使圍不解，宜悉誅之。

translations.literal: Fazhen and Chong'er again told the emperor, "Great ministers not attentive — causing siege not lifted — should all be executed."
translations.idiomatic: Fazhen and Chong'er again told the emperor, "Great ministers not attentive — causing siege not lifted — should all be executed."

sentences.zh: 」珍國、張稷懼禍，乃謀應蕭衍，以計告後合舍人錢強。

translations.literal: " Zhenguo and Zhang Ji fearing disaster — then plotted to respond to Xiao Yan, telling the plan to rear-hall attendant Qian Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: "Zhenguo and Zhang Ji fearing disaster — then plotted to respond to Xiao Yan, telling the plan to rear-hall attendant Qian Qiang.

sentences.zh: 強許之，密令遊蕩主崔叔智夜開雲龍門，稷及珍國勒兵入殿，分軍又從西上合入後宮，禦刀豐勇之為內應。

translations.literal: Qiang promised; secretly ordered wandering-drive chief Cui Shuzhi at night to open Cloud Dragon Gate; Ji and Zhenguo led troops entering the hall; divided armies also from west upper chambers entering rear palace — Imperial Knife Feng Yongzhi as inner collaborator.
translations.idiomatic: Qiang promised; secretly ordered wandering-drive chief Cui Shuzhi at night to open Cloud Dragon Gate; Ji and Zhenguo led troops entering the hall; divided armies also from west upper chambers entering rear palace — Imperial Knife Feng Yongzhi as inner collaborator.

sentences.zh: 是夜，帝在含德殿。

translations.literal: That night the emperor was in Hede Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That night the emperor was in Hede Hall.

sentences.zh: 吹笙歌作女兒子，臥未熟，聞兵入，趨出北戶，欲還後宮。

translations.literal: Blowing reed pipe singing girl-children songs, lying not yet asleep — hearing troops enter, rushed out north door, wishing to return rear palace.
translations.idiomatic: Blowing reed pipe singing girl-children songs, lying not yet asleep — hearing troops enter, rushed out north door, wishing to return rear palace.

sentences.zh: 清曜合已閉，閹人禁防黃泰平刀傷其膝，僕地，顧曰：「奴反邪！

translations.literal: Qingyao chambers already closed; eunuch guard Huang Taiping blade wounded his knee — falling, looking back said, "Slave rebels?"
translations.idiomatic: Qingyao chambers already closed; eunuch guard Huang Taiping blade wounded his knee — falling, looking back said, "Slave rebels?"

sentences.zh: 」直後張齊斬首，送蕭衍。

translations.literal: " Direct Attendant Zhang Qi beheaded, sent to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: "Direct Attendant Zhang Qi beheaded, sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 宣德太后令依漢海昏侯故事，追封東昏侯。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Xuande ordered following Han Marquess of Haihun precedent — posthumously enfeoffed Marquess of Donghun.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Xuande ordered following Han Marquess of Haihun precedent — posthumously enfeoffed Marquess of Donghun.

sentences.zh: 和帝諱寶融，字智昭，明帝第八子也。

translations.literal: Emperor He, taboo name Baorong, style name Zhizhao, was Emperor Ming's eighth son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor He, whose taboo name was Baorong and style name Zhizhao, was Emperor Ming's eighth son.

sentences.zh: 建武元年，封隨郡王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianwu, enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianwu, enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 永元元年，改封南康王，出為西中郎將、荊州刺史，督七州軍事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongyuan, re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nankang; sent out as Western Palace General, Governor of Jing Province, commanding seven provinces' military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongyuan, re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nankang; sent out as Western Palace General, Governor of Jing Province, commanding seven provinces' military affairs.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月甲寅，長史蕭穎胄奉王舉兵。

translations.literal: In the second year, eleventh month on jiayin, Chief Clerk Xiao Yingzhou installed the prince raising troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, eleventh month on jiayin, Chief Clerk Xiao Yingzhou installed the prince raising troops.

sentences.zh: 其日太白及辰星俱見西方。

translations.literal: That day Venus and Mercury both appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: That day Venus and Mercury both appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，教纂嚴。

translations.literal: On yimao, ordered strict guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, ordered strict guard.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以雍州刺史蕭衍為使持節、都督前鋒諸軍事。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Governor of Yong Province Xiao Yan was made acting authority, Commander of Vanguard Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Governor of Yong Province Xiao Yan was made acting authority, Commander of Vanguard Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊午，衍表勸進。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Yan memorialized urging advancement.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Yan memorialized urging advancement.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，群僚勸進，並不許。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on yihai, officials urged advancement — all not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yihai, officials urged advancement — all not permitted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，驍騎將軍夏侯亶自建鄴至江陵，稱宣德太后令：「西中郎將南康王宜纂承皇祚，光臨億兆，可且封宣城王、相國、荊州牧，加黃鉞，置僚屬。

translations.literal: On renchen, Rapid Cavalry General Xiahou Dan from Jianye reached Jiangling, stating Empress Dowager Xuande's order: "Western Palace General Prince of Nankang should succeed the imperial line, preside over the hundred million — may for now be enfeoffed Prince of Xuancheng, Chancellor, Governor of Jing Province, given yellow axe, staff appointed."
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Rapid Cavalry General Xiahou Dan from Jianye reached Jiangling, stating Empress Dowager Xuande's order: "Western Palace General Prince of Nankang should succeed the imperial line, preside over the hundred million — may for now be enfeoffed Prince of Xuancheng, Chancellor, Governor of Jing Province, given yellow axe, staff appointed."

sentences.zh: 」三年正月乙巳，王受命，大赦；

translations.literal: " In the third year, first month on yisi, the prince received mandate; general amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: "In the third year, first month on yisi, the prince received mandate; general amnesty;

sentences.zh: 唯梅蟲兒、茹法珍等不在例。

translations.literal: Only Mei Chong'er, Ru Fazhen and others not within the scope.
translations.idiomatic: Only Mei Chong'er, Ru Fazhen and others not within the scope.

sentences.zh: 是日，長星見，竟天。

translations.literal: That day a long comet appeared spanning the sky.
translations.idiomatic: That day a long comet appeared spanning the sky.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，建牙于城南。

translations.literal: On jiayin, military teeth established south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, military teeth established south of the city.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，群僚上尊號，立宗廟及南北郊。

translations.literal: In the second month on jisi, officials submitted exalted title; ancestral temple and southern and northern suburbs established.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jisi, officials submitted exalted title; ancestral temple and southern and northern suburbs established.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，詔假黃鉞蕭衍，若定京邑，得以便宜從事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on jiwei, an edict lent yellow axe to Xiao Yan — if Jing city settled, might act as expedient.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiwei, an edict lent yellow axe to Xiao Yan — if Jing city settled, might act as expedient.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬寅，尚書令、鎮軍將軍蕭穎胄卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on renyin, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Garrisons the Army Xiao Yingzhou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter on renyin, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Garrisons the Army Xiao Yingzhou died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，建康城平。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on bingyin, Jianye city pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on bingyin, Jianye city pacified.

sentences.zh: 己巳，宣德皇太后令，以征東大將軍蕭衍為大司馬、錄尚書、驃騎大將軍、揚州刺史，封建安郡公，依晉武陵王遵承制故事。

translations.literal: On jisi, Empress Dowager Xuande ordered Grand General Who Conquers the East Xiao Yan as Grand Marshal, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, Rapid Cavalry General, Governor of Yang Province, enfeoffed Duke of Jian'an Commandery — following Jin Prince of Wuling Zun's assumption-of-power precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Empress Dowager Xuande ordered Grand General Who Conquers the East Xiao Yan as Grand Marshal, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, Rapid Cavalry General, Governor of Yang Province, enfeoffed Duke of Jian'an Commandery — following Jin Prince of Wuling Zun's assumption-of-power precedent.

sentences.zh: 壬申，改封建安王寶寅為鄱陽王。

translations.literal: On renshen, re-enfeoffed Prince of Jian'an Baoyin as Prince of Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, re-enfeoffed Prince of Jian'an Baoyin as Prince of Poyang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以司徒、揚州刺史晉安王寶義為太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Grand Tutor and Governor of Yang Province Prince of Jin'an Baoqi made Grand Commandant, holding Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Grand Tutor and Governor of Yang Province Prince of Jin'an Baoqi made Grand Commandant, holding Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以尚書右僕射王瑩為左僕射。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Ying made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Ying made Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊戌，宣德皇太后臨朝，入居內殿。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month on wuxu, Empress Dowager Xuande held court, entering inner halls.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month on wuxu, Empress Dowager Xuande held court, entering inner halls.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大司馬蕭衍都督中外諸軍事，加殊禮。

translations.literal: On renyin, Grand Marshal Xiao Yan commanded all military affairs within and without, with extraordinary honors added.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Grand Marshal Xiao Yan commanded all military affairs within and without, with extraordinary honors added.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以大司馬長史王亮為守尚書令。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Grand Marshal Senior Clerk Wang Liang made Acting Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Grand Marshal Senior Clerk Wang Liang made Acting Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，加大司馬蕭衍位相國，梁公，備九錫禮。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Grand Marshal Xiao Yan promoted to rank Chancellor, Duke of Liang, complete Nine Bestowals ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Grand Marshal Xiao Yan promoted to rank Chancellor, Duke of Liang, complete Nine Bestowals ritual.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，誅湘東王寶晊。

translations.literal: In the second month on renxu, Prince of Xiangdong Baoqi executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on renxu, Prince of Xiangdong Baoqi executed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，進梁公蕭衍爵為王。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Duke of Liang Xiao Yan promoted to rank King.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Duke of Liang Xiao Yan promoted to rank King.

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉，禪詔至，皇太后遜居外宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on xinyou, abdication edict arrived — Empress Dowager yielded dwelling outer palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on xinyou, abdication edict arrived — Empress Dowager yielded dwelling outer palace.

sentences.zh: 梁受命，奉帝為巴陵王，宮于姑孰。

translations.literal: Liang received mandate; installed the emperor as Prince of Baling, housed at Gushu.
translations.idiomatic: Liang received mandate; installed the emperor as Prince of Baling, housed at Gushu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，巴陵王殂，年十五。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Prince of Baling died, aged fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Prince of Baling died, aged fifteen.

sentences.zh: 追尊為齊和帝，葬恭安陵。

translations.literal: Posthumously honored as Emperor He of Qi; burial at Gong'an Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously honored as Emperor He of Qi; burial at Gong'an Tomb.

sentences.zh: 初，梁武帝欲以南海郡為巴陵國邑而遷帝焉，以問範雲，雲俛首未對。

translations.literal: Initially Liang Emperor Wu wished to make Nanhai Commandery the Baling princedom territory and move the emperor there — asked Fan Yun; Yun bowed head without answering.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Liang Emperor Wu wished to make Nanhai Commandery the Baling princedom territory and move the emperor there — asked Fan Yun; Yun bowed head without answering.

sentences.zh: 沈約曰：「今古殊事，魏武所雲，'不可慕虛名而受實禍'。

translations.literal: Shen Yue said, "Present and ancient different affairs — Wei Wu what he said, 'cannot admire empty name and receive real calamity.'"
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yue said, "Present and ancient different affairs — Wei Wu what he said, cannot admire empty name and receive real calamity."

sentences.zh: 」梁武頷之。

translations.literal: " Liang Emperor Wu nodded.
translations.idiomatic: "Liang Emperor Wu nodded.

sentences.zh: 於是遣鄭伯禽進以生金，帝曰：「我死不須金，醇酒足矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon dispatched Zheng Boqin advancing with living gold — the emperor said, "My death needs no gold — pure wine suffices."
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon dispatched Zheng Boqin advancing with living gold — the emperor said, "My death needs no gold — pure wine suffices."

sentences.zh: 」乃引飲一升，伯禽就加折焉。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he drew and drank one sheng; Boqin then added poison.
translations.idiomatic: "Thereupon he drew and drank one sheng; Boqin then added poison.

sentences.zh: 先是，文惠太子與才人共賦七言詩，句後輒云：「愁和帝」，至是其言方驗。

translations.literal: Previously Crown Prince Wenhu with a talented lady together composed seven-character poems — after each line saying "sorrow and Emperor He" — at this the words were verified.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Crown Prince Wenhu with a talented lady together composed seven-character poems — after each line saying sorrow and Emperor He — at this the words were verified.

sentences.zh: 又永明中，望氣者雲新林、婁湖、青溪並有天子氣，于其處大起樓苑宮觀，武帝屢游幸以應之；

translations.literal: Also in Yongming, diviners of qi said Xinlin, Lou Lake and Qing Stream all had Son of Heaven qi — at those places great tower gardens and palace halls were raised; Emperor Wu repeatedly toured to respond;
translations.idiomatic: Also in Yongming, diviners of qi said Xinlin, Lou Lake and Qing Stream all had Son of Heaven qi — at those places great tower gardens and palace halls were raised; Emperor Wu repeatedly toured to respond;

sentences.zh: 又起舊宮於青溪，以弭其氣。

translations.literal: Also raised Old Palace at Qing Stream to suppress its qi.
translations.idiomatic: Also raised Old Palace at Qing Stream to suppress its qi.

sentences.zh: 而明帝舊居東府城西，延興末，明帝龍飛，至是梁武帝眾軍城于新林，而武帝舊宅亦在征虜。

translations.literal: Yet Emperor Ming's old dwelling was east of Eastern Headquarters city; at Yanxing's end Emperor Ming dragon-rose — at this Liang Emperor Wu's mass of armies encircled at Xinlin, and Emperor Wu's old residence also at Conquering Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Emperor Ming's old dwelling was east of Eastern Headquarters city; at Yanxing's end Emperor Ming dragon-rose — at this Liang Emperor Wu's mass of armies encircled at Xinlin, and Emperor Wu's old residence also at Conquering Barbarians.

sentences.zh: 百姓皆著下屋白紗帽，而反裙覆頂。

translations.literal: Common people all wore lower-garment white gauze caps, and reversed skirt covering the crown.
translations.idiomatic: Common people all wore lower-garment white gauze caps, and reversed skirt covering the crown.

sentences.zh: 東昏曰：「裙應在下，今更在上，不祥。

translations.literal: Marquess of Donghun said, "Skirt should be below — now again above — inauspicious."
translations.idiomatic: Marquess of Donghun said, "Skirt should be below — now again above — inauspicious."

sentences.zh: 」命斷之。

translations.literal: " Ordered cut off.
translations.idiomatic: "Ordered cut off.

sentences.zh: 於是百姓皆反裙向下，此服祅也。

translations.literal: Thereupon common people all reversed skirts downward — this clothing was an omen.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon common people all reversed skirts downward — this clothing was an omen.

sentences.zh: 帽者首之所寄，今而向下，天意若曰，元首方為猥賤乎。

translations.literal: Cap is where the head rests — now downward — Heaven's intent seems to say, the sovereign about to become base and vile.
translations.idiomatic: Cap is where the head rests — now downward — Heaven's intent seems to say, the sovereign about to become base and vile.

sentences.zh: 東昏又令左右作逐鹿帽，形甚窄狹，後果有逐鹿之事。

translations.literal: Marquess of Donghun also ordered attendants to make deer-chase caps — shape very narrow — afterward indeed there was deer-chase affair.
translations.idiomatic: Marquess of Donghun also ordered attendants to make deer-chase caps — shape very narrow — afterward indeed there was deer-chase affair.

sentences.zh: 東昏宮裏又作散叛發，反髻根向後，百姓爭學之，及東昏狂惑，天下散叛矣。

translations.literal: Within Marquess of Donghun's palace also made scattered-rebel hair — reversed bun roots backward — common people competed to learn; when Marquess of Donghun went mad, all under Heaven scattered and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Within Marquess of Donghun's palace also made scattered-rebel hair — reversed bun roots backward — common people competed to learn; when Marquess of Donghun went mad, all under Heaven scattered and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 東昏又與群小別立帽，騫其口而舒兩翅，名曰：「鳳度三橋「。

translations.literal: Marquess of Donghun with petty men separately made caps — opening the mouth and spreading two wings, called "Phoenix Crossing Three Bridges."
translations.idiomatic: Marquess of Donghun with petty men separately made caps — opening the mouth and spreading two wings, called Phoenix Crossing Three Bridges.

sentences.zh: 裙向後，總而結之，名曰：「反縛黃麗」。

translations.literal: Skirt backward, gathered and knotted, called "Reverse-Bound Yellow Li."
translations.idiomatic: Skirt backward, gathered and knotted, called Reverse-Bound Yellow Li.

sentences.zh: 東昏與刀敕之徒親自著之，皆用金寶，鑿以璧璫。

translations.literal: Marquess of Donghun with knife-edict fellows personally wore them — all used gold and treasure, carved with jade and ear ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: Marquess of Donghun with knife-edict fellows personally wore them — all used gold and treasure, carved with jade and ear ornaments.

sentences.zh: 又作著調帽，鏤以金玉，間以孔翠，此皆天意。

translations.literal: Also made tuning caps — carved with gold and jade, mixed with peacock — all Heaven's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Also made tuning caps — carved with gold and jade, mixed with peacock — all Heaven's intent.

sentences.zh: 梁武帝舊宅在三橋，而「鳳度」之名，鳳翔之驗也。

translations.literal: Liang Emperor Wu's old residence at Three Bridges — and "Phoenix Crossing" name — phoenix flying verification.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Emperor Wu's old residence at Three Bridges — and Phoenix Crossing name — phoenix flying verification.

sentences.zh: 「黃麗」者「皇離」，為日而反縛之，東昏戮死之應也。

translations.literal: "Yellow Li" is "emperor departed" — as sun yet reverse-bound — Marquess of Donghun slaughter-death response.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Li is emperor departed — as sun yet reverse-bound — Marquess of Donghun slaughter-death response.

sentences.zh: 「調」者，梁武帝至都，而風俗和調。

translations.literal: "Tuning" — Liang Emperor Wu reaching the capital, and customs harmoniously tuned.
translations.idiomatic: Tuning — Liang Emperor Wu reaching the capital, and customs harmoniously tuned.

sentences.zh: 先是百姓及朝士，皆以方帛填胸，名曰：「假兩」，此又服祅。

translations.literal: Previously common people and court gentlemen all used square silk filling the chest — called "false two" — this again clothing omen.
translations.idiomatic: Previously common people and court gentlemen all used square silk filling the chest — called false two — this again clothing omen.

sentences.zh: 假非正名也，儲兩而假之，明不得真也。

translations.literal: False is not correct name — storing two yet false — bright not obtaining true.
translations.idiomatic: False is not correct name — storing two yet false — bright not obtaining true.

sentences.zh: 東昏誅，其子廢為庶人，假兩之意也。

translations.literal: Marquess of Donghun executed, his son deposed commoner — false-two intent.
translations.idiomatic: Marquess of Donghun executed, his son deposed commoner — false-two intent.

sentences.zh: 論曰：郁林地居長嫡，瑕釁未彰，而武皇之心，不變周道，故得保茲守器，正位尊極。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Yulin occupied eldest legitimate position; faults not yet manifest — yet Emperor Wu's heart unchanged from Zhou Way — therefore could preserve the vessel, correct position utmost honor.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary says: Yulin occupied eldest legitimate position; faults not yet manifest — yet Emperor Wu's heart unchanged from Zhou Way — therefore could preserve the vessel, correct position utmost honor.

sentences.zh: 既而愆鄙內作，兆自宮闈，雖為害未遠，而足傾社稷。

translations.literal: Then vulgar faults arose within; omen from inner quarters — though harm not yet far, enough to overturn state and altars.
translations.idiomatic: Then vulgar faults arose within; omen from inner quarters — though harm not yet far, enough to overturn state and altars.

sentences.zh: 郭璞稱永昌之名，有二日之象，隆昌之號，實亦同焉。

translations.literal: Guo Pu said Yongchang's name has two-sun image; Longchang's title also same.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu said Yongchang's name has two-sun image; Longchang's title also same.

sentences.zh: 明帝越自支庶，任當負荷，乘機而作，大致殲夷，流涕行誅，非雲義舉，事苟非安，能無內愧。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming overstepped from branch line, responsibility ought to bear load — seizing opportunity to act, broadly exterminated; flowing tears executing — not called righteous rising; affairs if not secure, how without inner shame.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming overstepped from branch line, responsibility ought to bear load — seizing opportunity to act, broadly exterminated; flowing tears executing — not called righteous rising; affairs if not secure, how without inner shame.

sentences.zh: 既而自樹本枝，根胤孤弱，貽厥所授，屬在凶愚，用覆宗祊，亦其理也。

translations.literal: Then himself planted root branches; descendants solitary weak — what was entrusted to posterity rested on fierce folly — thus overturning ancestral temple — also its principle.
translations.idiomatic: Then himself planted root branches; descendants solitary weak — what was entrusted to posterity rested on fierce folly — thus overturning ancestral temple — also its principle.

sentences.zh: 夫名以行義，往賢垂範，備而之禪，術士誡之，東昏以「卷」名，「藏」以終之，其兆先征，蓋亦天所命矣。

translations.literal: Names take meaning from conduct; former sages leave model; complete yet abdicate — technicians warned; Marquess of Donghun with "quan" name, "zang" to end — its omen fore-sign — also Heaven's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Names take meaning from conduct; former sages leave model; complete yet abdicate — technicians warned; Marquess of Donghun with quan name, zang to end — its omen fore-sign — also Heaven's mandate.
